title: onboard-aurora-slim-7b-v1.1-metadata-perf-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Add Aurora-slim 7B v1.1 to the model registry with production-ready metadata, validated performance profiles, and a small changelog/release-notes automation hook so model onboarding is recorded in release notes automatically. This PR bundles model metadata (license, tokenizer, architecture, quantization recommendations), perf profiles generated from the benchmark-lab harness for typical sequence length distributions, and a GitHub Actions workflow that triggers the registry changelog generator when new model versions land.

Summary of changes: Adds models/aurora-slim/7b/v1.1/metadata.yaml and perf_profiles.json, updates registry index, adds .github/workflows/model-changelog.yml to trigger the changelog generator and upload release fragment, and a tiny helper script scripts/regen-changelog.sh used by automation. Also includes README entry for aurora-slim and an integration test case in tests/registry/test_onboard_aurora_slim.py.

Checklist: [x] metadata schema validated against registry schema (tools/validators/metadata_validator.py) [x] perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab nightly harness and re-run locally [x] changelog automation tested locally (workflow simulated) [x] unit/integration tests added and passing [x] Linear references added (ENG-2245, ENG-2278).

Testing & validation: perf profiles were produced using benchmark-lab commit 0a1b2c3 and include throughput/latency samples for sequence lengths 32/128/512. Integration tests exercise registry API (create model version, fetch metadata, validate perf profile shapes). Local simulation of the GitHub Action writes a release fragment to .changes/fragments/aurora-slim-7b-v1.1.md which the changelog generator picks up.

Rollout notes: After merge, model is available in the registry index and visible to the console. Default serving recommendation is quantized int4 on A800-class GPUs for cost-conscious workloads; recommend canary rollout for Dedicated customers per ENG-2245. The changelog generator will include this onboarding in the next release notes automatically.

Related: ENG-2245 (model onboarding), ENG-2278 (changelog automation).
